identity.gauge_sha256: record raw NERSC file SHA-256 per configuration
identity.propagator_sha256: record cached propagator byte SHA-256 per configuration
identity.quda: record version string and libquda build hash
identity.device: record DCU model, driver and runtime
identity.trajectory_ids: join each configuration ID to the HMC manifest trajectory

protocol_sha256: fill with SHA-256 fingerprint of the frozen measurement protocol

checks.source: point at the origin; 12 spin-color right-hand sides
checks.fast_generic_consistency: same sink channel via both paths
checks.source_averaging: average over sources inside a configuration, then block across configurations

statistics.power_simulation: target effect vs block variance, pre-registered seed

freeze.primary_endpoint: paired risk difference on the validation split

budget.estimated_hours: measure and report pilot setup, solve, sink, I/O and total time

stop_rules: residual or gamma5 check fails -> stop before production
reference gate fails on the new development -> no score
power simulation shows the target effect is unreachable -> stop
